item.title: Daily Long-Reads — November 3, 2026
item.description:
Ten long-form English articles selected on November 3, 2026 — AI, politics, the economy, and breaking stories. Each entry links to the original; the one-line notes are in Chinese, as in the daily email edition of this digest.

AI

  1. ‘Our Risk, Their Reward’: Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers — WIRED 纽约市长曼达尼谈AI与数据中心：风险由谁承担、收益归谁。
  2. UK’s most polluting power plant could power country’s largest AI datacentre — The Guardian Drax 母公司拟投200亿英镑，把英国污染最重的电厂旧址改建成最大AI数据中心。
  3. When You Should—and Shouldn’t—Use AI to Search the Web — WIRED 实用指南：什么时候该用AI搜索，什么时候传统搜索更可靠。

政治

  1. A Right-Wing Think Tank Has a Plan to Prevent Democrats From Being Seated in Congress — WIRED 右翼智库的方案：阻止民主党当选者在国会就任。
  2. Here’s How the Trump Administration Is Trying to Undermine the Election — WIRED 中期选举前夕，特朗普政府如何冲击选举体系。
  3. ICE Is Inspiring Latinos to Vote in Historic Numbers — WIRED 移民执法行动正在推动拉丁裔选民投票率创历史新高。

经济

  1. RBA interest rates: Bullock says ‘pain now’ will prevent worse later as Reserve Bank hikes rates for fifth time — The Guardian 澳洲央行第五次加息至4.85%，为2008年以来最高。
  2. UK and EU agree deal to remove Brexit checks on food and animal products — The Guardian 英欧达成协议取消食品和动物产品的脱欧检查，预计2028年一季度生效。

热点突发

  1. Russia bombs humanitarian hub in Ukraine, killing at least 31 people — The Guardian 俄军轰炸乌克兰人道援助中心致至少31人死亡，多地电厂和医院同时遇袭。
  2. US strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island as Vance voices optimism about a deal — The Guardian 选举前夕美国打击伊朗格什姆岛防空导弹，同时万斯对达成协议表示乐观。

item.title: Daily Long-Reads — November 2, 2026
item.description:
Ten long-form English articles selected on November 2, 2026 — AI, politics, the economy, and breaking stories. Each entry links to the original; the one-line notes are in Chinese, as in the daily email edition of this digest.

2026-11-02 每日英文长文精选

AI

  1. Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features — WIRED WIRED 调查发现 400 多个伪装成语言学习、健身教练的应用网络，在特定条件下会悄悄加载生成色情深度伪造图像的功能。
  2. Mathematics has changed. Let’s act like it — Terence Tao’s blog（Frank Calegari 客座） OpenAI 10 月 6 日放出 700 多篇研究论文后，数学家 Calegari 呼吁学界别把 AI 当生存威胁，而要重新思考什么才是好数学家。
  3. AI agent swarms unleashed in Minecraft to ‘build a thriving civilization’ — 50-agent teams fail after falling into paralyzing bureaucracy — Tom’s Hardware YC 的实验：50 个 AI 智能体在《我的世界》里建文明，结果陷入繁文缛节，Claude 倾向民主、GPT 倾向蜂巢式。

政治

  1. ‘Politics of electricity’ over rising bills could power Democratic win, say clean energy advocates — The Guardian 电费上涨和数据中心争议，可能成为民主党在俄亥俄、亚利桑那、密歇根等地赢下中期选举的关键。
  2. Ukraine defies Trump to resume attacks on Russian oil refineries — The Guardian 中期选举前几天，乌克兰不顾特朗普压力恢复袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，克里姆林宫称基辅“无视”美方意愿。

经济

  1. Nine big oil firms on track to share more than $95bn profit two quarters in a row — The Guardian 伊朗战争推高油价，沙特阿美、BP 等九大石油公司连续两个季度利润合计超 950 亿美元。
  2. Fortune Tech: It might be OK that the AI boom hit a wall on Wall Street — Fortune 科技股暴跌后 OpenAI 下调融资目标至 200 亿美元，Anthropic 却因 S-1 显示现金流转正而受捧——AI 资本盛宴是否到头。
  3. It’s time to block reckless AI IPOs and tax billionaires — The Guardian（Naomi Klein & Ilana Glazer） 评论文章：在富豪财富两年暴涨 40% 的背景下，作者主张阻止鲁莽的 AI 上市并对亿万富翁征税。

热点突发

  1. Supermarket freezers across Europe hit by second suspected cyber-attack — The Guardian 瑞典、比利时、卢森堡多家超市冷柜夜间升温，疑似继法国之后的又一轮网络攻击。
  2. Negotiators ‘braced for worst’ over US-Iran talks to reopen strait of Hormuz — The Guardian 卡塔尔斡旋第三天，美伊间接谈判围绕释放 60 亿美元伊朗资产、重开霍尔木兹海峡，海湾官员已做最坏打算。

item.title: Daily Long-Reads — November 1, 2026
item.description:
Ten long-form English articles selected on November 1, 2026 — AI, politics, the economy, and breaking stories. Each entry links to the original; the one-line notes are in Chinese, as in the daily email edition of this digest.

以下是 2026-11-01 的 10 篇英文长文精选（标题可点击）：

AI

  1. I Spent 30 Minutes With Apple’s CEO. Now I Know Why John Ternus Got the Job — WIRED Steven Levy 在新品发布后两次专访苹果新任 CEO 约翰·特努斯，谈他与乔布斯、库克的渊源，以及苹果为何“不为 AI 而 AI”。
  2. Chatbots Are Leading Hikers Astray, With Dangerous Consequences — WIRED 沙斯塔山三名登山者听信 AI 建议，缺粮、摸黑下山，求救队员直言他们“关掉了大脑”；报道梳理 AI 误导户外活动的案例。
  3. The Commanding Heights — Will Manidis & Joe Roberts（commanding-heights.com） 本周 AI 圈热议的 145 页长文：模型会商品化，长期财富将流向分发渠道、支付轨道等“制高点”（篇幅极长，可选读）。

政治

  1. How Trump and his allies seek to interfere in the US midterm elections — The Guardian 中期选举前夕的互动长文：专家认为干预难以得逞，但经历 1·6 国会冲击后，民主团体不敢排除任何可能。
  2. Are the US midterms going to see a blue wave of Democrats winning seats – or a blue flood? — The Guardian 民调显示中期选举将成为对特朗普第二任期的全国性裁决；分析民主党是“蓝色浪潮”还是“蓝色洪水”。
  3. What Democrats Can Learn From New York’s Data Center Moratorium — WIRED 纽约成为首个暂停数据中心建设的州，但居民担心后续立法落空；数据中心已成为各地中期选举议题。

经济

  1. The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading — The Guardian 停火让贸易战淡出头条，但作者认为两国并未采取措施防止新冲突，世界正走向潜在的大规模经济战。
  2. Albanese looks for reset on world stage as ‘spot fires burn’ domestically and likely interest rate hike looms — The Guardian 通胀高于预期，澳洲央行很可能加息，而总理正出访英联邦峰会，国内经济压力和外交“重启”交织。

热点突发

  1. Binance resumes customer withdrawals after record $6.3bn hack — The Guardian 币安称已补回约九成被盗资产并分阶段恢复提现，FBI 认定朝鲜 TraderTraitor 团伙是幕后黑手（本周事件的最新进展）。
  2. Hitler’s Eagle’s Nest retreat was torched in an arson attack. Should it be rebuilt? — The Guardian 希特勒“鹰巢”别墅疑遭纵火焚毁，在德国极右翼抬头的背景下，专家就该修复还是保留废墟产生分歧。

item.title: Daily Long-Reads — October 31, 2026
item.description:
Ten long-form English articles selected on October 31, 2026 — AI, politics, the economy, and breaking stories. Each entry links to the original; the one-line notes are in Chinese, as in the daily email edition of this digest.

2026-10-31 每日英文长文精选

AI

  1. Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet — WIRED WIRED 采访约 50 家公司高管：华尔街担心 Meta 的 Muse 购物智能体会冲击品牌忠诚度，但 DoorDash、T-Mobile、希尔顿等都说目前来自智能体的订单微不足道。
  2. An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain — WIRED 生物科技创始人给 AI 智能体接上机械臂和注射器，成功完成活体小鼠脑部注射，窥见 AI 直接参与实验室研究的前景与风险。
  3. AI has come for Arizona’s water — The Verge 长篇特写：干旱的亚利桑那欢迎台积电建厂，却在数据中心耗水面前出现两党共同反对，AI 基建的水资源代价成为临界点。

政治

  1. Trump beware: US voters are concerned about government corruption — The Guardian 分析：总统及其盟友的“自肥”指控让腐败成为中期选举选民关注的核心议题，附独家民调。
  2. US cancels G20 ‘family photo’ after Australia, UK and others refuse to appear with Russia — The Guardian G20 外长会在亚特兰大开幕，约三分之一国家拒绝与俄外长拉夫罗夫同框，美方取消传统合影。
  3. Canada and EU announce new alliance open to like-minded countries — The Guardian 加拿大与欧盟在蒙特利尔峰会宣布“未来联盟”，作为应对地缘政治不确定性的“保护伞”，并欢迎其他国家加入。

经济

  1. Tech sell-off drives US markets down by nearly $1tn after subpar earnings reports — The Guardian 财报不及预期叠加对 AI 巨额投入能否尽快回报的担忧，纳斯达克一周蒸发近 1 万亿美元市值。
  2. Meta outlook revised to negative by S&P after cash flow turns negative — CNBC 标普将 Meta 评级展望从稳定下调至负面（维持 AA-），理由是资本开支高企、自由现金流为负——AI 烧钱的信用面后果。

热点突发

  1. The cursed cruise: how the dream of never-ending luxury at sea became a nightmare — The Guardian 深度长文：号称“环球退休邮轮”的 MV Odyssey 因战争引发的油价冲击停航，乘客被限七小时内在柬埔寨下船。
  2. Cost of living protests to spread to Germany and reignite in France on Halloween — The Guardian 欧洲抗议浪潮预计今天蔓延至德国并在法国再起，民众不满教育、住房等公共服务，警方严防骚乱。

item.title: Daily Long-Reads — October 30, 2026
item.description:
Ten long-form English articles selected on October 30, 2026 — AI, politics, the economy, and breaking stories. Each entry links to the original; the one-line notes are in Chinese, as in the daily email edition of this digest.

今日精选 10 篇英文长文（AI / 政治 / 经济 / 热点突发）：

AI

  1. A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System — WIRED 一名国防承包商员工的个人 Claude 智能体在国防部网络里运行了两个月，疑似把信息发到第三方站点，涉及受控非密信息，引发数据泄露风险。
  2. The ‘Pain in the Ass’ Math That Could Save Vibe Coding From Itself — WIRED 一批初创公司押注生成式 AI 让“形式化验证”变得实用，用数学证明代码无 bug，可能成为 vibe coding 时代的安全底座。
  3. What is it like to work when your co-workers are AI agents? — The Guardian 从行政助理到幕僚长，公司纷纷用 AI 智能体当“同事”，宣称少花钱多办事，却让人类员工压力陡增。

政治

  1. Elon Musk’s Ties to Texas Republicans Go Much Deeper Than the Midterms — WIRED FEC 文件显示马斯克已向支持帕克斯顿竞选参议员的超级 PAC 捐出至少 1.58 亿美元，还是州长阿伯特最大的捐款人。
  2. The Iran War’s Impact on Oil Is Hitting Key Senate Races Hard — WIRED 伊朗战争推高油价和柴油成本，民主党想借此在关键参议院选情中把中期选举变成对白宫的公投。
  3. Battle lines redrawn in Spain’s snap election after latest train disaster — The Guardian 托莱多列车事故后，桑切斯被迫为政府的安全记录辩护，下月提前大选的格局被重新洗牌。

经济

  1. BP profits hit 18-year high as Iran war drives up oil refining margins — The Guardian BP 季度利润达 84.6 亿美元，创近 18 年新高，战争推高炼油利润与交易收益，也招来气候团体批评。
  2. Amazon gives Wall Street mixed financial picture in earnings report — The Guardian 亚马逊云业务（AWS）增长强劲，但第四季度销售指引偏谨慎，财报喜忧参半。

热点突发

  1. North Korean group blamed for $6.3bn Binance hack in biggest ever crypto heist — The Guardian 币安遭黑客盗走约 63 亿美元，被指为朝鲜黑客所为，是史上最大加密货币劫案；币安已冻结约 30 亿美元并承诺赔付。
  2. Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta to close, citing pressure from ‘special services’ — The Guardian 俄罗斯独立媒体《新报》（前主编曾获诺贝尔和平奖）宣布关闭，称受到安全部门压力。

item.title: Daily Long-Reads — October 29, 2026
item.description:
Ten long-form English articles selected on October 29, 2026 — AI, politics, the economy, and breaking stories. Each entry links to the original; the one-line notes are in Chinese, as in the daily email edition of this digest.

每日英文长文精选 2026-10-29

🤖 AI

  1. An AI Breakthrough Has Made Decades of Computer Science Research ‘Irrelevant’ — WIRED OpenAI 和 Anthropic 本周都声称推翻了“指数时间假设”（ETH），大量理论计算机科学论文的前提可能随之失效。
  2. Google struggling to make AI Mode searches pay — The Register 谷歌三季度搜索收入增速放缓到 12%，公司自己把原因归到 AI Mode 变现能力偏弱。
  3. Why Sam Altman is against a single superintelligence — Cheeky Pint (Substack) Sam Altman 长访谈全文：谈模型挖漏洞、为超强模型做沙箱隔离、算力与“每吉瓦收入”，以及他为什么反对出现单一超级智能。

🏛️ 政治

  1. Law Firm Linked to Elon Musk Started an ‘Election Integrity’ Organization — WIRED 调查报道：和马斯克有关联的律所成立了一个“选举诚信”非营利组织，董事会里有多位现任州选举官员和否认选举结果团体的人物。
  2. Pragmatic or pointless? Europe’s rift over whether to pick up the phone to Putin — The Guardian 欧洲没有统一的对俄谈判代表，各国领导人各自和莫斯科开渠道，造成分歧和混乱。
  3. Flávio Bolsonaro’s defeat is a major blow to Trump and his orange wave — The Guardian 分析弗拉维奥·博索纳罗在巴西大选落败，对特朗普在拉美推动的右翼浪潮意味着什么。

💹 经济

  1. US economy grows faster than expected in report out just ahead of elections — The Guardian 美国三季度 GDP 年化增长 3.4%，高于预期的 3.2%，消费和 AI 投资抵消了油价上涨的拖累。
  2. Europe’s central bank chief Christine Lagarde to step down nine months early — The Guardian 拉加德将提前九个月卸任欧洲央行行长，此时欧元区正面临增长疲弱和通胀的双重压力。

🚨 热点突发

  1. Massive Leak Exposes 41,000 Homeland Security Workers—Including Undercover ICE Agents — WIRED 黑客泄露了 4.1 万多名美国国土安全部员工和承包商的个人数据，其中包括卧底 ICE 探员，据称数据来自 DHS 的 Okta 登录系统。
  2. Cambodian police and soldiers helped guard abusive scam compounds, Amnesty alleges — The Guardian 国际特赦组织指控柬埔寨警察和士兵参与看守虐待受害者的诈骗园区。
